news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 1 experienced director. 2 highly experienced directors. Non-Executive Independent Woman Director Shatabdi Jadhav was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2020. The company’s insufficient board refreshment is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.
